# Core-Kit AI Context Sitemap (`llms.txt`)
> High-performance polyglot engineering foundation (Go 1.27+, Python 3.14+, TypeScript/Bun 1.4+).
> Use this sitemap to locate authoritative specifications, architecture diagrams, contracts, and runbooks.
